tweet.text:
OpenAI wants you to just trust them that the NSA is excluded from their contract.

Katrina seems to believe she has been "very transparent," but there are many issues:

-Two days ago, you promised "a clear and more comprehensive explanation shortly" of how the NSA is excluded. https://x.com/natseckatrina/status/2028170853746159961?s=20
-Your explanation now is a single sentence, with no contract language showing the Title 50 exclusion you had claimed to exist. https://x.com/bradrcarson/status/2028693038743101690
-You appeared to play wordgames when answering a question about this previously. https://x.com/sjgadler/status/2027938781681357012?s=20
-More generally, the DoW / intelligence agencies are notorious for exactly this kind of wordplay. https://x.com/ciphergoth/status/2028218732854853739?s=20
-And many specific loopholes have been pointed out re: your NSA statements. https://x.com/David_Kasten/status/2028649586349228284?s=20
-The full language is necessary because of defense contract 'escape hatches': There might be language to supercede a clause's meaning in ways not visible from the clause alone. https://x.com/_NathanCalvin/status/2028674866124083623?s=20
-You've implied that Anthropic was misleading about their contract details, and that "seeing the contract language" would clarify things. Why doesn't this apply for you? https://x.com/natseckatrina/status/2028661282354721184?s=20
-Even OpenAI's own employees are asking for independent legal analysis to red-team the contract, which can't happen without the language. https://x.com/j_asminewang/status/2028648242666496092?s=20

I truly appreciate that you're moving fast and have probably been working around the clock, but I hope it's clear why, without strong evidence to the contrary, people are mistrusting OpenAI on this.
